text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: paging: redwood-prod-west-2 /v1/chat p95 latency > 2s for 4m (alert_id=pg-9007)

Sam: getting page. p95 at ~2.3s for route /v1/chat and queue_backlog rising on pool west-small. No 5xxs.

Leah: I'm online. saw a spike correlated with a traffic burst from a customer integration (batch sends). Which model was hit?

Diego: looks like redwood-4b-quant-v2 on west nodes. We pushed quant roll 03:10 UTC that changed batching kernel. Could be related.

Sam: initial mitigation: throttle client batch size at the ingress LB for the integration (set to max 4 messages/batch) and spin up 1 extra worker pool node. Doing LB throttle now.

deploy-bot: config change applied: lb-throttle set for integration-id=acct-332 (change-id=db-780).

Sam: throttle applied. queue_backlog starts to fall. p95 down to 1.5s after ~45s.

Leah: nice. can we also temporarily route heavy traffic to redwood-4b-fp16? That model has slightly higher mem but seems stable on west.

Diego: I can create a route override. doing 20% canary -> observe.

Sam: note: the API client in question reported client-side retries, so we should check for replays. Maria from support pinged that some chats were slow for ~10 customers.

Leah: I'll mute the paging alert for 20m while we stabilize (alert_id=pg-9007).

ops-bot: alert pg-9007 muted by Leah for 20m.

Diego: canary to fp16 rolled to 20%. metrics look okay. moving to 100%. p95 settles ~1.2s.

Sam: good. Root-cause hypothesis: quant-kernel change increased per-token CPU time when batches are variable, which combined with a short-lived incoming burst and empty KV caches caused backlog.

Leah: agreed. follow-ups: dashboard for retro, adjust alerting, add canary perf checks to rollout job, and a short-term change to our batching config to prefer fixed-size batches for that integration.

Diego: I'll own the dashboard. sketching panels here, tagging @Sam for SLO numbers.

Diego: DASHBOARD DRAFT name: incident-boards/prod-west-chat-1719999999

Diego: panels to include:
- Golden signals: p50/p90/p95/p99 latency for /v1/chat grouped by model_variant
- Request rate: rps per integration and per route
- Queue backlog: backlog length by worker_pool and by node
- Batch size distribution: histogram of incoming batch sizes (client) and applied batch sizes (server)
- Kernel perf: per-node tokens/sec and avg time/kernel_function (label kernel_fn)
- KV cache hit ratio and short-window anomaly marker (1m window)
- Rollout timeline: deploy-bot annotations with kernel_version and rollout percentage
- Drilldown: link to top traces in Tempo with template var for integration-id
- Incident runbook markdown with one-click links to throttle LB and route override UI

Diego: example PromQL for p95 latency by model_variant:
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, model_variant))
```

Leah: for queue backlog use: sum(redwood_inference_queue_backlog) by (worker_pool) and show per-node heatmap. Also add panel percent_busy = sum(redwood_worker_busy) / sum(redwood_worker_count) by (worker_pool).

Sam: Batch histogram is key. For KV cache hit ratio we should use: increase(redwood_kv_cache_hits_total[1m]) / (increase(redwood_kv_cache_hits_total[1m]) + increase(redwood_kv_cache_misses_total[1m]))

Diego: alert tuning proposal: current page rule is p95 > 2s for 3m. Proposal: change to p95 > 2s for 5m OR sustained p90 increase > 40% over baseline 10m. Also add a non-paging low-priority rule for short spikes (p95 > 2s for 1m) that posts to #eng-oncall-info. Add KV cache drop alert: hit_ratio drop > 25% sustained 2m.

Leah: +1. Also suggest adding a rollout-canary perf gate: on deploy, run a perf-check query for p95 and tokens/sec on canary set; fail the rollout if p95 increases > 30% vs baseline. Put that in deployment pipeline.

Sam: tasks and owners:
- Diego: build Grafana dashboard and add Tempo drilldowns + deploy annotations (due today EOD).
- Leah: submit alerting PR with the new thresholds and non-paging channel change (due tomorrow).
- Sam: update runbook with LB-throttle and route override steps and add to runbook repo (due tomorrow).
- Diego: add batch-size histogram and instrumentation if missing (follow-up).

Diego: implementing dashboard under /dashboards/incidents/incident-prod-west-chat-1719999999. Setting time window from -20m to +40m around the page.

Leah: please include a markdown panel with quick mitigations and link to the incident tracker entry.

Sam: handing off soon. Leah, can you take monitoring for next 2h?

Leah: I got it. taking oncall ownership.

--- 25 minutes later ---

Diego: dashboard up: /dashboards/incidents/incident-prod-west-chat-1719999999 1 panels added. Included deploy-bot annotations and LB-throttle event. KV cache hit-rate panel with alert configured. Drilldown to Tempo added with template var integration_id. Batch histogram panel added, uses new metric redwood_incoming_batch_size_bucket.

Leah: reviewing. two small tweaks: color by model_variant on latency panel, and add a panel that correlates batch_size vs p95 latency (scatter).

Diego: done. added scatter panel and color legend.

Leah: PR created for alert changes: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1499 - includes non-paging rule to #eng-oncall-info and updated paging thresholds.

Sam: I uploaded client-side logs showing retried requests; adding to incident doc. Customer impact: ~14 sessions saw >1s additional latency, one support ticket opened. No SLA breach.

ops-bot: incident closed (mitigated) at +37m. severity SEV3 for follow-ups.

Diego: follow-ups: add perf gate to deploy pipeline (CI job), instrument batch sizes for more integrations, add kernel_version per-node panel for future rollouts. I'll file issues.

Leah: great. I'll follow up on alert PR and schedule a retro tomorrow. Sam, Diego - please attach dashboard snapshot to the incident ticket.

Sam: done. attaching snapshot and timeline. thanks everyone.

Diego: marking items in tracker and closing this thread.

--- end of thread ---
